name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Cherry Jolli Popz + Watermelon Jolli Popz
description:
Two candy classics, one device. Cherry Jollipopz brings rich, sweet flavor while Watermelon Jollipopz adds a juicy, refreshing twist. Flip between the two or combine them for a smooth, fruit-forward blend.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
